component.name: Xueqing
学情
component.summary: 以学生学情为核心的长期教学工作台

description.p: Xueqing is a native Linux desktop client built with GTK4, libadwaita, and .NET 10. It helps teachers record classroom observations, track long-term learning cases, and manage today's teaching follow-up actions with fail-closed local encryption backed by SQLite3MC and Linux Secret Service.
